entities.summary: Second Republic, a political institution in Maldives during Twentieth Century Transformation (1954–1968). Grew from Amin Didi and Constitutional Sultanate and Amin Didi. Led to the emergence of Independence and Second Republic and Maldives gains full independence from Britain.
